visuals.caption: Atrophic acne scars: ice-pick, boxcar and rolling.

manage.lead: Prevent by treating acne early; scar treatment is specialist and multi-session.

points: Treat active acne **early and adequately**; scarring = refer (NG198).
Ice-pick: TCA CROSS, punch excision / grafting.
Boxcar: fractional laser, peels, punch, microneedling.

limits.t: Higher PIH risk: experienced operator only.

items.t: Scarring or significant distress at any acne severity (NG198).
Low mood or body dysmorphic concerns: mental-health support.

quiz.q: Which atrophic scar type is commonest?
How do you tell PIH from a scar?
quiz.a: PIH is flat colour change with no contour change.

quiz.q: What does NICE say about scarring?
quiz.a: Scarring is a referral trigger at any acne severity.
